summary: WebRender, Firefox’s GPU-based page renderer, received major improvements to backdrop filters—the effects that blur or otherwise filter content behind an element—so they can capture and draw the right parts of a page more efficiently. It also gained support for CSS path clipping and SVG gradients, with refinements to antialiasing, shadows, and border rendering. Other changes make GPU uploads and compositor behavior more reliable and extend WebRender’s control over which embedded frames a page may display.
